// diagnostic

E0986

This callable marker is detached from its declaration head.

What

This callable marker is detached from its declaration head.

Why

Layout must keep `->`, `-[Effects]>`, `::`, or the opening brace attached to the function head so the declaration boundary is unambiguous.

Fix

Move the marker or opening brace onto the same logical line as the closing `)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0986: tests/ui/return_arrow_split.stderr.

Error [E0986]: `->` must stay on the same line as the closing `)`
  --> tests/ui/return_arrow_split.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     -> Int {
    |     ^^
 Why: an arrow, effect row, or opening block continues the header on its line
 Fix: move `->` up to the `)` line
